name: Pulseboard
summary: A live sales control room for an online store, made for a wall screen or TV
about: A dark, neon wall screen that shows an online store's sales and traffic as they happen. Orders ping on a dot-matrix world map with arcs from the warehouse, revenue counts up, a stream of orders per minute scrolls and alert rules ring the bell when live numbers cross a line. Good for a shop owner's control room, an office TV or a store front.
how: Watch the Live page: every new order pings on the map, joins the feed and the ticker, and moves revenue, stock and the top products.
Press the LIVE pill to pause or resume the data; it also stops by itself when the tab is hidden.
Open Orders to search, filter and sort the live table, freeze it, and pack, ship or refund an order from its drawer.
On Products, restock an item or pause it; low stock rings the bell.
On Goals & alerts, set daily goals and add rules such as conversion below 2.5%; fired alerts land in the bell and the log.
Switch Traffic between 7D, 30D and 12M, and turn on TV mode in Settings to cycle the pages on a timer.
